sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 31 points from 13 games and on an impressive five-game league winning streak, face AFC Bridgnorth away on Saturday 24 October at 15:00. They then host Dawley Town at home on Saturday 31 October, also at 15:00. Both fixtures present opportunities for the leaders to extend their dominant form, though Dawley's recent win suggests they will not be easy opponents.
divisionWide: Second-placed Bilston Town (26 points) face a stern test against in-form Allscott Heath, who despite sitting eighth have won five of their last six league matches. Third-placed Stafford Town host Shawbury United on 24 October before travelling to face Telford Town on 31 October; Stafford's solid recent form (two wins in last six) should see them favoured in both. AFC Bridgnorth, fifth with 24 points, host Sandbach on 24 October before their fixture list continues later in the month. Eccleshall (7th, 22 points) travel to Telford Town on 27 October in a midweek clash, then host Shawbury United on 31 October. Brereton Social, in 14th place, face Cheadle Heath Nomads on 31 October after playing Dawley Town on 24 October. Market Drayton Town (14 points) host Cheadle Heath on 24 October and travel to face Crewe on 31 October. Cheadle Heath Nomads (14 points) have a busy week playing both Market Drayton on 24 October and Brereton Social on 31 October. Foley Meir host Widnes Town on 24 October and then welcome Barnton on 31 October. Struggling Widnes Town (6 points) travel to Foley Meir on 24 October before hosting Alsager Town (7 points) on 31 October—a fixture between two of the division's weakest sides. New Mills face Wednesfield Community on 31 October, with New Mills slightly favoured at home. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth with 25 points, host Allscott Heath on 31 October. Barnton travel to face Foley Meir on 31 October after their recent four-game winning run suggests they remain competitive. Crewe host Market Drayton Town on 31 October as they seek to build on their recent solitary win.
